# Journal of the Indian Mathematical Society

Journal of the Indian Mathematical Society was a journal dedicated to the service of students and teachers of mathematics in India.

### Publication History

Journal of the Indian Mathematical Society began in 1909 as Journal of the Indian Mathematical Club for two volumes. In 1911, from volume three, the name was changed to Journal of the Indian Mathematical Society. No issue or contribution copyright renewals were found for this serial. (More details) A new series began in 1934. It is still published today.

### Persistent Archives of Complete Issues

  * 1909-1930: HathiTrust has volumes 1-18 of the Journal of the Indian Mathematical Club and the Journal of the Indian Mathematical Society freely readable online. Access may be restricted outside the United States. Some later issues are available for search only.
  * 1929: The Internet Archive has a supplement to volume 17, reporting on the Indian Mathematical Societys sixh conference.

### Official Site / Current Material

  * The journal home page has more information about the journal, and links to articles from recent issues available for subscription or payment.
